description:
Anti-hallucination confirmation gate (kosma-style): verify interpretation claims
are grounded in the chart before publishing them.
chart_json = exact JSON from compute_natal_chart or get_current_transits.
claims = JSON array: [{"text": "...", "factors": [
    {"type": "aspect", "a": "Sun", "b": "Moon"},        # aspect exists in chart
    {"type": "planet_house", "a": "Sun", "b": 5},        # planet is in that house
    {"type": "planet_sign", "a": "Sun", "b": "Leo"},     # planet is in that sign
    {"type": "house_sign", "a": 5, "b": "Leo"}]}]        # house cusp is in that sign
A claim is supported only if >= 2 of its factors independently exist in the chart.
Returns per-claim verdicts; gate = "blocked" if any claim is unsupported — rewrite
the claim against verified factors or drop it.
name: validate_interpretation
title: Validate Interpretation
